Rina (CSM): Kicking off Meridian Health onboarding. Marta says they need PHI-safe private deployment + go-live in ~6 weeks. Quick sync: owners, top risks, and must-have success metrics? :wave:
Marta (Client POC): Hi all - main goals: anonymized triage, <250ms median latency at 50 QPS, and a short ops runbook. Security team also requested a network diagram and DPA.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Private deployment ok. Need expected peak QPS and model size. Marta: peak 50 QPS, bursts to 100, model = 13B open LLM. I'll sketch capacity rec and infra checklist.
Priya (Impl Manager): I'll run enablement. Proposed cadence: 3 workshops + 2 office hours. Will share a session plan today.
Jordan (CS Lead): Legal/DPA is a blocker risk; suggest we start Security questionnaire this week and loop Legal. Also recommend executive intro before week 3 to reduce renewal risk.
Rina (CSM): Proposed success criteria: ["median latency <250ms at 50QPS","99.9% uptime business hours","integration tests pass with sample payloads","DPA signed and security checklist complete","runbook + enablement recorded"]. I'll add to shared onboarding doc.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Infra checklist excerpt: `- VPC peering
- Restricted egress to model registry and monitoring
- KMS key access
- IAM role for runtime
- Prometheus metrics endpoint`
ClientBot: Calendar invites created for Discovery (Tue 10:00 PT) and Infra deep-dive (Thu 11:00 PT).
Priya (Impl Manager): I'll publish the workshop outlines and weekly timeline. Who will own prompt tuning?
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll lead prompt tuning and baseline tests (synthetic + sample traces). Plan to measure p50/p95/p99 and token cost.
Marta (Client POC): Sounds good. I'll confirm internal stakeholders and forward security contact.
Rina (CSM): Action items: Omar -> infra checklist & perf plan, Priya -> workshop schedule, Jordan -> start DPA/security routing, Rina -> stakeholder RACI + success criteria. Aim for Discovery next Tue. :thumbsup:
Jordan (CS Lead): Noted, starting security doc handoff now.
Rina (CSM): Thanks team, will update thread after checklist and invites are in place. :lock:
